vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Yes. Vita Kamliuk (also listed professionally as Viktoryia Kamliuk) is a Los Angeles–based real estate agent.

She is currently affiliated with Compass. Her official Compass profile lists her as REALTOR®, California DRE #02166055, with specialties including buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management. She speaks English and Russian. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

Her own website says she focuses on residential real estate throughout Greater Los Angeles, particularly the San Fernando Valley (including Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana and Westlake Village) and the Westside/Beverly Hills/West Hollywood area. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

Her background is somewhat unusual for an LA residential agent. She says she previously worked in commercial real estate with Knight Frank and Colliers International and has roughly 18 years of industry experience across the U.S. and overseas. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

You may find older information saying she's with Keller Williams Beverly Hills. That's not necessarily a different person: a 2022 VoyageLA profile identified her as working at Keller Williams BH at that time. More recent sources, including her current Compass profile and 2026 professional activity, establish that she's now with Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))

Her current publicly listed contact details are:
- Brokerage: Compass
- California DRE: #02166055
- Phone: 310-706-1668
- Email: vita.kamliuk@compass.com ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent transactions, listings/sales history, client reviews, and any California DRE disciplinary history to give you a more independent assessment.
